Hook Text

Visual Hook

Por que Funciona

El hook funciona porque combina una promesa específica (six-figure run rate) con la eliminación de barreras comunes (zero experience, zero resources), activando tanto aspiración como curiosidad. La mención del año 2026 añade urgencia y relevancia inmediata.

Script Sugerido

Start with a question or statement that grabs attention. Establish credibility. Explain the business opportunity. Highlight the benefits. End with a clear call to action.

Estrategia de CTA

Filosofia Soft-Sell

🎯 Core Philosophy: • Nomely is NOT the main focus — it's simply a tool in the process • The video is about the JOURNEY, not the product • Think product placement, not advertisement • Show, don't tell

Que SI Hacer

  • ✅ DO:
  • • Show website via quick phone scroll/zoom (2-3 sec max)
  • • Mention briefly and naturally, then move on immediately
  • • Focus on the overall workflow and value
  • • Make it feel organic, like you actually use it
  • • Let the viewer discover it themselves

Que NO Hacer

  • ❌ DON'T:
  • • Talk directly about product features
  • • Hard sell or push the product
  • • Make Nomely the center of attention
  • • Linger on the website/app screen
  • • Use affiliate phrases ('use my link', 'sign up now')
  • • Break the video flow for a product pitch

Ejemplo de Integracion

💡 Integration Example: "...so I hop on Nomely to check availability..." [quick phone scroll showing website — 2 seconds] "...and boom, the name's available. Now let's see if..." Total mention: ~3 seconds Style: Natural, discreet, part of the workflow
